correctness.rationale: The n-1 criterion is proved in both directions by observing that with exactly one vertex x outside a maximum set, every nonedge inside the set must have a geodesic through x. This is equivalent to every complement-neighbor of x being a leaf. The resulting complement star-component decomposition reduces a Nordhaus--Gaddum equality case to r<=1, and the two cases force exactly K_{2,n-2} or K_2 join independent_{n-2}, up to complementation.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. arXiv:2609.18877v1 introduces connected mutual visibility, proves the Nordhaus--Gaddum bounds, and gives sharpness examples, but does not characterize mu_c=n-1 or classify all equality graphs. Exact and synonymous searches found no prior theorem implying these results.

value.rationale: The result characterizes the second-largest possible value of a newly introduced graph invariant and converts two sharp Nordhaus--Gaddum inequalities into complete equality classifications for all orders n>=5.

disclaimer: Not independent validation, peer review, or a guarantee of first discovery.
